title: Posterior cortex holds activity for as long as a percept lasts

statements.text: During conscious perception of a visual stimulus, some sites in posterior cortex hold sustained activity that tracks how long the stimulus is seen, as integrated information theory predicted in the Cogitate adversarial test.
statements.scope: suprathreshold visual stimuli of 0.5 to 1.5 seconds, intracranial EEG, Cogitate experiment 1

standing.reason: Proposed for integration in the seed proposal, pending the user's review.

sources.quote: For prediction 2 (maintenance of conscious content), IIT posits that conscious content is actively maintained in the posterior cortex
In posterior cortex ROIs, 25 electrodes (out of 657) measured sustained activity tracking stimulus duration
